meta.title: 2027 NBA player ratings — Owner-supplied
meta.source: Owner-supplied list, pasted into the council session on 2026-10-21
meta.source_class: owner-supplied ratings (the Owner approved the data; the POOL still needs the Owner's final approval, and the per-record fields below are not yet in it)
meta.rubric: n/a — these are the Owner's own ratings, not a council-rating exercise
notes: Positions are NOT in the source: this list carries name, tier and rating only. Position candidates (PG/SG/SF/PF/C) must come from another source before a draft can staff a lineup.
Franchises are NOT in the source: the roster assignment is open.
This is a CURRENT-league list (2027 ratings), so it is the substrate for priority 3 (current NBA), not for priority 4 (all-time NBA).

The rating scale here runs 67..97, while the football build's OVR runs 70..99. The two sports' scales are not directly comparable; the NBA pack needs its own value curve (the analogue of slotWins/modelWeights).

Names are reproduced exactly as the Owner supplied them. Where the source appears to have dropped diacritics, the name is left as-is and listed below as a note for the player browser, not silently corrected.
meta.kind: OWNER-SUPPLIED RATINGS — a rated list, NOT yet an engine-ready pool: positions and franchises are not in the source

meta.positions_note: Positions are the council's, not the Owner's: 538 records, each with a confidence flag (high/medium/low). Franchises are NOT set here — the Owner's 2K export is the franchise source, per her direction.
